newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ, Qantas, Telstra issue joint card.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ, Qantas, Telstra issue joint card.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ )on Wednesday launched a new credit card in conjunction with Australia's Qantas Airways Ltd and state-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp.

Holders of the Qantas Telstra Visa card will be able to redeem reward points for Qantas frequent flyer points and flights as well as Telstra products and ANZ reward points which carry a monetary value, the bank said in a statement.
Reward points are accumulated at a rate of two for every dollar charged to the card as well as bonus points at special outlets.
ANZ said the new card was expected to be as successful as its Telstra Visa card, which has attracted about 400,000 cardholders since its launch in June last year.
